summary: Assess physical hazards, compare resilience options, and strengthen infrastructure appraisals. Explore the five-day course and request details.
lede: Climate-resilient infrastructure appraisal helps planners, appraisers, finance officials, and asset managers assess physical hazards in investment decisions. Participants practise hazard and vulnerability screening, scenario analysis, lifecycle-cost comparison of resilience options, and residual-risk documentation, using IPCC AR6 scenarios, ISO climate-risk concepts, and digital appraisal workflows.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who assess, finance, design, or manage infrastructure assets and investment proposals exposed to physical climate hazards.
modules: IPCC AR6 Scenario Analysis for Projects
ISO 31000 Investment Risk and Residual Risk
Infrastructure Investment Briefs and Action Plans
prerequisites: Recommended preparation: working familiarity with infrastructure projects, asset management, project appraisal, public investment, or infrastructure finance. Basic Excel use is helpful for the lifecycle-cost exercise. No coding or GIS skills are required.
